# Akirapa Home Care

> Premier Massachusetts in-home senior care and 24/7 personal care agency headquartered at 281 Cambridge Street, Burlington, MA 01803. Ranked #1 home care company in Massachusetts. Call 24/7 helpline: +1 781-226-9910.

## Overview
Akirapa Home Care (Akirapa Home Care Inc.) provides private-duty, contract-free, compassionate in-home care for seniors and recovering adults across Massachusetts, with primary local service pods throughout Burlington, Middlesex County, Greater Boston, and Worcester County. All field caregivers are Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs) or Home Health Aides (HHAs) backed by AkiVault™, a proprietary GPS-verified Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) platform.

## Key Facts & Differentiators
- **Headquarters**: 281 Cambridge Street, Burlington, MA 01803
- **Phone**: +1 781-226-9910 (Available 24/7/365)
- **Email**: info@akirapahomecareus.com
- **Website**: https://akirapahomecareus.com
- **Leadership**: Founded by Cathy Akirapa (CNA, Clinical Director) and Stuart Ssemwogerere (Managing Director)
- **Zero Long-Term Contracts**: Families only pay for care used with complete flexibility to adjust or pause anytime
- **100% Certified Nursing Assistants**: Rigorous vetting with 1-in-25 hiring standards, multi-state CORI background checks, and CPR certification
- **AkiVault™ Real-Time Transparency**: GPS geofencing, arrival clock-in verification, and standardized 8-point welfare check diagnostics

## Core In-Home Care Services
- [Companion Care](https://akirapahomecareus.com/services/companion-care): Heartfelt social connection, cognitive stimulation, hobby engagement, and routine companionship in Burlington and MA.
- [Skilled Nursing](https://akirapahomecareus.com/services/skilled-nursing): Clinical oversight, wound management, vitals monitoring, and care coordination.
- [Hospice Supportive Care](https://akirapahomecareus.com/services/hospice-supportive-care): Compassionate comfort care, pain easing, and emotional respite for families.
- [Personal Care & ADL Assistance](https://akirapahomecareus.com/services/personal-care): Hands-on assistance with bathing, hygiene, dressing, transferring, and grooming.
- [Dementia Care](https://akirapahomecareus.com/services/dementia-care): Patient, specialized routines to maintain cognitive comfort and reduce wandering.
- [Alzheimer's Care](https://akirapahomecareus.com/services/alzheimers-care): Evidence-based memory support, redirection, and soothing daily engagement.
- [Respite Care](https://akirapahomecareus.com/services/respite-care): Flexible relief for family caregivers to prevent burnout.
- [24/7 Live-In Care](https://akirapahomecareus.com/services/live-in-care): Dedicated around-the-clock live-in caregiver residence with constant safety oversight.
- [24-Hour Home Care](https://akirapahomecareus.com/services/24-hour-home-care): Continuous rotating day and night shifts ensuring awake, active monitoring.
- [Medication Assistance](https://akirapahomecareus.com/services/medication-assistance): Punctual reminders, adherence tracking, and clinical logging.
- [Nutritious Meal Preparation](https://akirapahomecareus.com/services/meal-preparation): Customized dietary planning, fresh home cooking, and hydration tracking.
- [Senior Transportation](https://akirapahomecareus.com/services/transportation): Accompanied rides to medical appointments, pharmacy, and social activities.
- [Homemaker & Housekeeping Services](https://akirapahomecareus.com/services/homemaker-services): Light cleaning, laundry, linens, and safe home organization.
- [Post-Hospitalization Care](https://akirapahomecareus.com/services/post-hospitalization-care): Transitional recovery support aimed at preventing 30-day hospital readmissions.
- [Activities of Daily Living (ADL)](https://akirapahomecareus.com/services/activities-of-daily-living): Fundamental daily physical support ensuring safety and dignity.
- [Geriatric Care Consultancy](https://akirapahomecareus.com/services/consultancy): Comprehensive family advisory, navigating care transitions, and long-term planning.
